links: Futur and Conditionnel share the stem circuler-. Learn one and you have both.
The Imparfait stem circul- is the nous form of the Présent (circulons) with -ons removed.
The Subjonctif stem circul- is the ils form of the Présent (circulent) with -ent removed.
The Impératif is the Présent with the pronoun dropped.
